title: Lime Totem
description: Transform the classic look of the Totem of Undying with the Lime Totem! This exclusive texture replaces the default totem with a vibrant lime-green/moss design and glowing red eyes, perfect for anyone wanting a unique, mystical, or toxic look in-game.
